items.definition:
a set of ideas, figures, or devices that provide a basis or foundation for something
The theory's underpinning is based on extensive research.

the state or condition of being a woman
She celebrated her journey into womanhood.

A person from whom one is descended; an ancestor.
He traced his family tree back to his ascendants from the 17th century.

a loose hood or draped neckline
She pulled the cowl of her cloak over her head to keep warm.

the transfer of authority from central to local government
The company is considering decentralization to improve efficiency.

behavior in keeping with good taste and propriety
He conducted himself with decorum during the formal dinner.

the state of being a slave
The history of enslavement is a dark chapter for humanity.

an adjective or descriptive phrase expressing a quality
He was often called by the epithet 'the Great'.

a small fleet of ships or boats
A flotilla of fishing boats sailed out at dawn.

courageous behavior, especially in battle; polite attention or respect given by men to women
His gallantry on the battlefield earned him a medal.

the complete range or scope of something
The play covered the whole gamut of human emotions.

a system of complementary medicine in which ailments are treated by minute doses of natural substances that in larger doses would produce symptoms of the ailment
Many people are skeptical about the effectiveness of homeopathy.

a servant or follower, especially one who is obsequious or subservient
He was tired of being treated like a mere lackey by his boss.

a type of white blood cell
Macrophages play a crucial role in the immune system by engulfing pathogens.

the spread of cancer cells from the place where they first formed to another part of the body
The doctors were concerned about the possibility of metastasis.

a commandment or good deed in Judaism
Performing acts of charity is considered a great mitzvah.

the branch of science dealing with the oceans
She decided to pursue a career in oceanography after studying marine life.

prejudice in favor of a particular cause; bias
The debate was marred by extreme partisanship from both sides.

the distortion or corruption of something from its original course, meaning, or state
He saw the new policy as a perversion of justice.

a container or device that holds something
Please place your trash in the appropriate receptacle.

the quality of being fierce or cruel
The film depicted the savagery of war.

obscene material; dirt
The book was criticized for containing too much smut.

a concession; a piece of food dipped in liquid
The small raise was just a sop to keep the employees from complaining.

a long, angry speech
The manager launched into a tirade about the team's poor performance.

great respect; reverence
The ancient texts were held in deep veneration by the scholars.

the sideways movement of an aircraft or vessel
The pilot corrected the aircraft's yaw.

the positive electrode in an electrolytic cell
Electrons flow from the anode to the cathode.

a chemical element, a light metal
Beryllium is used in aerospace components.

a thorny bush or shrub
He got tangled in the briar patch while walking through the woods.

the ability of a system to store an electric charge
The capacitance of the circuit determines how much charge it can hold.

a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior
Her sudden caprice led her to quit her job and travel the world.

distress or embarrassment at having failed or been humiliated
To her chagrin, she realized she had forgotten her lines on stage.

a member of a people of southern Russia and Ukraine, noted for their horsemanship
The Cossack cavalry was known for its fierce fighting skills.

a member of the lowest caste in India
The documentary shed light on the struggles faced by the Dalit community.

moral or cultural decline as characterized by excessive indulgence
The empire's fall was attributed to its period of decadence.

analysis of a text or concept, often by breaking it down into its components
The literary critic applied deconstruction to the classic novel.

moral corruption; wickedness
The novel explored the depths of human depravity.

intrusion on a person's territory, rights, or property
The new building represents an encroachment on public land.

a powerful synthetic opioid
Fentanyl is a highly potent pain medication.

technology that seeks to improve and automate the delivery and use of financial services
The fintech industry is rapidly transforming banking.

a comic character in traditional pantomime, typically masked and dressed in a diamond-patterned costume
The harlequin entertained the audience with his acrobatic tricks.

a highly poisonous plant or a type of evergreen tree
Socrates was condemned to drink hemlock.

a state of being abnormally or unusually active
The child's hyperactivity made it difficult for him to sit still.

the action of provoking unlawful behavior or exciting a strong emotion
The speech was criticized for its incitement to violence.

the state of being well known for some bad quality or deed
The attack was a day that would live in infamy.

the quality or state of having a particular kind of mind or mental attitude
His open-mindedness allowed him to consider new ideas.

a Muslim legal expert empowered to give rulings on religious law; civilian clothes
The soldiers were allowed to wear mufti on their day off.

the lowest point; the point opposite the zenith
His career reached its nadir after the scandal.

A person or thing differing from all other members of a particular group or set.
In the data set, that particular value was a clear outlier.

A member of an ancient Jewish sect, distinguished by strict observance of the traditional and written law.
In the Bible, Jesus often criticized the hypocrisy of the Pharisees.

A deposit of sand or gravel in the bed of a river or lake, containing particles of valuable minerals.
Gold was discovered in the placer deposits along the river.

The scope of the influence or concerns of something.
This matter falls outside the purview of my department.

The metallic element mercury; something that moves or changes very quickly.
His mood was as changeable as quicksilver.

local coagulation or clotting of the blood in a part of the circulatory system
Deep vein thrombosis is a serious condition.

an international encoding standard for use with different languages and scripts
Unicode allows computers to represent text from almost all writing systems.

A weight class in boxing and other combat sports.
The boxer moved up to the welterweight division for his next fight.

Formal release from guilt, obligation, or punishment.
The priest granted him absolution for his sins.

A mixture or blend.
The band's music was an amalgam of jazz, rock, and blues.

The act of annulling something; invalidation.
The couple sought an annulment of their marriage.

a colorless, volatile, flammable liquid hydrocarbon
Benzene is a known carcinogen.

a large art exhibition or festival held every two years
The Venice Biennale is a renowned international art exhibition.

concise and exact use of words in writing or speech
The brevity of his speech was appreciated by the audience.

a strong verbal attack; or, the simultaneous firing of all guns from one side of a warship
The politician delivered a broadside against his opponent.

a light-colored, air-cured tobacco
Burley tobacco is commonly used in cigarette blends.
